task_instance: Scaffold a new Terraform Plugin Framework provider named terraform-provider-demo: create workspace, init Go module, add terraform-plugin-framework dependency, write main.go and internal/provider/provider.go (with schema + Configure supporting endpoint/api_key config with DEMO_ENDPOINT/DEMO_API_KEY env fallback), run go mod tidy, go build, and go test.
evidence: Created /tmp/.../terraform-provider-demo workspace. Ran `go mod init github.com/example/terraform-provider-demo` (go.mod created). Ran `go get -u github.com/hashicorp/terraform-plugin-framework@latest` which succeeded over the network (added v1.19.0, auto-upgraded go directive to 1.25.0 as required by the dependency). Wrote main.go (providerserver.Serve wiring) and internal/provider/provider.go (DemoProvider struct implementing provider.Provider, Metadata/Schema/Configure/Resources/DataSources, endpoint+api_key attributes resolved from explicit config with DEMO_ENDPOINT/DEMO_API_KEY env var fallback, per skill instructions). Ran `go mod tidy` (resolved and downloaded transitive deps: grpc, x/net, x/text, etc., exit 0). Ran `go build -o /dev/null ./...` -> exit 0 (compiles cleanly). Ran `go test ./...` -> exit 0 ('no test files', expected since no resources/tests were added, but package compiles and is testable). No TODO comments were left in the final main.go/provider.go except two explicitly intentional placeholders (registry address and resource/data-source registration) which mirror the skill's own upstream assets/main.go and assets/provider.go pattern (those asset files were not present in the ce_sources copy of the skill, so the provider.go/main.go content was reconstructed from the skill's textual instructions and standard terraform-plugin-framework conventions). The skill's core deliverable -- a working, buildable, testable Terraform Plugin Framework provider scaffold -- was produced and verified end-to-end.
